description: This line plot compares the performance of two methods, labeled “Ours” and “ReFICR,” across five different values on the x-axis, which represents the number of interactions or iterations, ranging from 1 to 5 without units. The y-axis on the left, labeled “Recall@50,” is scaled linearly from 0.30 to 0.60, and the y-axis on the right, labeled “NDCG@50,” is scaled linearly from 0.15 to 0.22. The plot contains four lines: the solid green line with circular markers (“Recall@50 (Ours)”) starts at 0.35 and increases to 0.49; the dashed green line with circular markers (“Recall@50 (ReFICR)”) remains constant at 0.47 across all x-values; the solid blue line with square markers (“NDCG@50 (Ours)”) starts at 0.32 and increases to 0.46; and the dashed blue line with square markers (“NDCG@50 (ReFICR)”) remains constant at 0.16 across all x-values.
